definitions.explanation: A dog trained to work with police — for tracking suspects or missing people, detecting drugs and explosives, and other operational duties.

examples.japanese: {警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}っている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The police dog is following the suspect's scent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧。
examples.english: The police dog safely located the hiker who had gone missing on the mountain.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧ (police) + {犬|けん} (dog, on'yomi). Common breeds used in Japan include German shepherds and Labrador retrievers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to deploy a police dog
- {警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{臭|にお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: for a police dog to follow a scent
- {警察犬|けいさつけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: police-dog training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盲導犬|もうどうけん}→盲導犬：24240_moudouken⟧: guide dog (for the blind)
- ⟦{麻薬|まやく}→麻薬：18796_mayaku⟧⟦{探知|たんち}→探知：20796_tanchi⟧{犬|けん}: drug-detection dog — a more specialized term for one role of {警察犬|けいさつけん}
